export type Vec2 = { x: number; z: number }

export function add(a: Vec2, b: Vec2): Vec2 {
  return { x: a.x + b.x, z: a.z + b.z }
}

export function sub(a: Vec2, b: Vec2): Vec2 {
  return { x: a.x - b.x, z: a.z - b.z }
}

export function scale(v: Vec2, k: number): Vec2 {
  return { x: v.x * k, z: v.z * k }
}

export function dot(a: Vec2, b: Vec2): number {
  return a.x * b.x + a.z * b.z
}

export function length(v: Vec2): number {
  return Math.hypot(v.x, v.z)
}

export function distance(a: Vec2, b: Vec2): number {
  return length(sub(a, b))
}

export function normalize(v: Vec2): Vec2 {
  const len = length(v)
  return len === 0 ? { x: 0, z: 0 } : { x: v.x / len, z: v.z / len }
}

export function yawOf(v: Vec2): number {
  return Math.atan2(v.x, v.z)
}

export function fromYaw(yaw: number): Vec2 {
  return { x: Math.sin(yaw), z: Math.cos(yaw) }
}

export function yawTo(from: Vec2, to: Vec2): number {
  return yawOf(sub(to, from))
}

export function yawDelta(from: number, to: number): number {
  const tau = Math.PI * 2
  let delta = (to - from) % tau
  if (delta <= -Math.PI) delta += tau
  if (delta > Math.PI) delta -= tau
  return delta
}

export function turnTowards(yaw: number, target: number, maxDelta: number): number {
  const delta = yawDelta(yaw, target)
  if (Math.abs(delta) <= maxDelta) return target
  return yaw + Math.sign(delta) * maxDelta
}

export function withinArc(origin: Vec2, yaw: number, target: Vec2, range: number, arcDeg: number): boolean {
  const dist = distance(origin, target)
  if (dist > range) return false
  if (dist === 0) return true
  const half = (arcDeg / 2) * (Math.PI / 180)
  return Math.abs(yawDelta(yaw, yawTo(origin, target))) <= half
}
